name: bakeoff
description: Run two-provider research and competitive build bakeoffs with replayable ledgers and artifact-only judging.

interface.shortDescription: Run two-provider research and build bakeoffs from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Bakeoff is a small CLI-first harness for running the same research or build task through two provider CLIs, judging artifact outputs, and writing replayable run ledgers.
defaultPrompt: Create a Bakeoff work order for this review or build.
